description: Belmont-sur-Lausanne provides a combined plan of its drinking-water, sewerage and low-voltage electricity networks. The plan covers municipal infrastructure and excludes networks belonging to other organisations. Source geometry comes from surveys and digitisation. The metadata give a publication date of 7 July 2021, continuous maintenance, a recommended scale of 1:250 and CH1903+ coordinates. Free orders are offered in DWG, DXF, PDF and paper formats, with a maximum area of 200,000 square metres. The legal-use field contains an unfinished instruction to add a remark, so no usable reuse licence is established. The plan does not include every conduit in service, and positions require local verification. Its geometry can support utility-network representation and exposure analysis, but connectivity, capacity and current completeness remain unverified. Related records describe the separate Pully network plan and Lausanne underground cadastre. The last displayed metadata update is December 2022, and Viageo's public demo label leaves production access unresolved. No extract was ordered or downloaded.
